firmware.name: PGEKI2
firmware.notes: 录制改为约4 KiB分块异步写入，修复启用蓝牙后的录制内存不足与残留忙状态

notesI18n.zh-CN: 录制改为约4 KiB分块异步写入，修复启用蓝牙后的录制内存不足与残留忙状态
notesI18n.en: Streams recordings asynchronously in roughly 4 KiB chunks, fixing recording allocation failures with Bluetooth enabled and stale busy status

firmware.name: PGEKI2
firmware.notes: 新增蓝牙配置、按键与摇杆状态、动作录制回放控制；移动端隐藏USB功能

notesI18n.zh-CN: 新增蓝牙配置、按键与摇杆状态、动作录制回放控制；移动端隐藏USB功能
notesI18n.en: Adds Bluetooth configuration, button and lever state, action recording/playback control, and hides USB-only features on mobile

firmware.name: PGEKI2
firmware.notes: 新增8槽动作录制与回放，记录按键、摇杆和事件时序；双核异步保存并为其他配置保留至少2 MiB storage空间

notesI18n.zh-CN: 新增8槽动作录制与回放，记录按键、摇杆和事件时序；双核异步保存并为其他配置保留至少2 MiB storage空间
notesI18n.en: Adds eight action recording slots with button, lever and event timing capture; dual-core asynchronous storage preserves at least 2 MiB for other configuration data

firmware.name: PGEKI2
firmware.notes: 配置槽0独立保存RAW/IO4模式，IO4可切换到槽位1到5的RAW键鼠复合模式

notesI18n.zh-CN: 配置槽0独立保存RAW/IO4模式，IO4可切换到槽位1到5的RAW键鼠复合模式
notesI18n.en: Slot 0 stores the RAW/IO4 mode; IO4 can switch to the RAW keyboard/mouse composite mode in slots 1–5
